supportingConnections.hypothesis: Most of the remaining built-app delay sits in one stage between data arrival and paint; measuring the stages finds it. Refuted if the time spreads evenly with no stage over ~30%.

status.comment:
Measured 2026-11-22 on this repo (951 ideas), backend in-process: project.loadIdeas 150-180 ms returning 1.44 MB; phase.list ~30 ms; getMeta 1.5 s cold, 2 ms after. About half of the transfer is text the canvas does not draw (status comments 469 KB, descriptions 315 KB). The backend is not the slow part; transfer and client work (value calculation, layout settling) are the candidates, which only a browser trace shows.

Felix: what feels slow? Pick an option (number key in the inbox). Then I take one browser trace before changing anything.
